verses.original: πρῶτον πάντων οὖν Παρακαλῶ δεήσεις προσευχάς ἐντεύξεις εὐχαριστίας ποιεῖσθαι ὑπὲρ πάντων ἀνθρώπων
verses.transliteration: prōton pantōn oun Parakalō deēseis proseuchas enteuxeis eucharistias poieisthai hyper pantōn anthrōpōn
verses.literal: First of all then I urge that petitions prayers intercessions [and] thanksgiving be offered for everyone . . .

verses.original: ὑπὲρ βασιλέων καὶ πάντων τῶν ὄντων ἐν ὑπεροχῇ ἵνα διάγωμεν ἤρεμον καὶ ἡσύχιον βίον ἐν πάσῃ εὐσεβείᾳ καὶ σεμνότητι
verses.transliteration: hyper basileōn kai pantōn tōn ontōn en hyperochē hina diagōmen ēremon kai hēsychion bion en pasē eusebeia kai semnotēti
verses.literal: for kings and all those . . . in authority so that we may lead tranquil and quiet lives in all godliness and dignity

verses.original: τοῦτο καλὸν καὶ ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον Θεοῦ ἡμῶν τοῦ Σωτῆρος
verses.transliteration: touto kalon kai apodekton enōpion Theou hēmōn tou Sōtēros
verses.literal: This [is] good and pleasing in the sight of God our - Savior

verses.original: ὃς θέλει πάντας ἀνθρώπους σωθῆναι καὶ ἐλθεῖν εἰς ἐπίγνωσιν ἀληθείας
verses.transliteration: hos thelei pantas anthrōpous sōthēnai kai elthein eis epignōsin alētheias
verses.literal: who wants everyone . . . to be saved and to come to [the] knowledge of [the] truth

verses.original: γὰρ Εἷς Θεός καὶ εἷς μεσίτης Θεοῦ καὶ ἀνθρώπων ἄνθρωπος Χριστὸς Ἰησοῦς
verses.transliteration: gar Heis Theos kai heis mesitēs Theou kai anthrōpōn anthrōpos Christos Iēsous
verses.literal: For [there is] one God and [there is] one mediator between God and men [the] man Christ Jesus

verses.original: ὁ δοὺς ἑαυτὸν ἀντίλυτρον ὑπὲρ πάντων τὸ μαρτύριον ἰδίοις καιροῖς
verses.transliteration: ho dous heauton antilytron hyper pantōn to martyrion idiois kairois
verses.literal: who gave Himself [as] a ransom for all the testimony that was given vvv at just the right time

verses.original: εἰς ὃ ἐγὼ ἐτέθην κῆρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀληθείᾳ διδάσκαλος ἐθνῶν λέγω ἀλήθειαν οὐ ψεύδομαι
verses.transliteration: eis ho egō etethēn kēryx kai apostolos en pistei kai alētheia didaskalos ethnōn legō alētheian ou pseudomai
verses.literal: For [this reason] I was appointed as a preacher - an apostle [and] a faithful and true teacher of [the] Gentiles I am telling [the] truth [I am] not lying [ about anything ]

verses.original: οὖν Βούλομαι τοὺς ἄνδρας ἐν παντὶ τόπῳ προσεύχεσθαι ἐπαίροντας ὁσίους χεῖρας χωρὶς ὀργῆς καὶ διαλογισμοῦ
verses.transliteration: oun Boulomai tous andras en panti topō proseuchesthai epairontas hosious cheiras chōris orgēs kai dialogismou
verses.literal: Therefore I want the men vvv vvv everywhere to pray lifting up holy hands without anger [or] dissension

verses.original: Ὡσαύτως καὶ γυναῖκας κοσμεῖν ἑαυτάς ἐν κοσμίῳ καταστολῇ μετὰ αἰδοῦς καὶ σωφροσύνης μὴ ἐν πλέγμασιν καὶ χρυσίῳ ἢ μαργαρίταις ἢ πολυτελεῖ ἱματισμῷ
verses.transliteration: Hōsautōs kai gynaikas kosmein heautas en kosmiō katastolē meta aidous kai sōphrosynēs mē en plegmasin kai chrysiō ē margaritais ē polytelei himatismō
verses.literal: Likewise [I want] [the] women to adorn themselves with respectable apparel with modesty and [with] self-control not with braided hair or gold or pearls or expensive clothes

verses.original: ἀλλ’ δι’ ἀγαθῶν ἔργων ὃ πρέπει γυναιξὶν ἐπαγγελλομέναις θεοσέβειαν
verses.transliteration: all’ di’ agathōn ergōn ho prepei gynaixin epangellomenais theosebeian
verses.literal: but with good deeds [as] is proper for women [who] profess to worship God

verses.original: Γυνὴ μανθανέτω ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ ἐν πάσῃ ὑποταγῇ
verses.transliteration: Gynē manthanetō en hēsychia en pasē hypotagē
verses.literal: A woman must learn in quietness [and] full submissiveness

verses.original: δὲ οὐκ ἐπιτρέπω γυναικὶ διδάσκειν οὐδὲ αὐθεντεῖν ἀνδρός ἀλλ’ εἶναι ἐν ἡσυχίᾳ
verses.transliteration: de ouk epitrepō gynaiki didaskein oude authentein andros all’ einai en hēsychia
verses.literal: - vvv I do not permit a woman to teach [or] to exercise authority over a man - she is to remain - quiet

verses.original: γὰρ Ἀδὰμ ἐπλάσθη πρῶτος εἶτα Εὕα
verses.transliteration: gar Adam eplasthē prōtos eita Heua
verses.literal: For Adam was formed first and then Eve

verses.original: καὶ οὐκ Ἀδὰμ ἠπατήθη δὲ ἡ γυνὴ ἐξαπατηθεῖσα γέγονεν ἐν παραβάσει
verses.transliteration: kai ouk Adam ēpatēthē de hē gynē exapatētheisa gegonen en parabasei
verses.literal: And [it was] not Adam [who] was deceived but the woman [who] was deceived [and] fell into transgression

verses.original: δὲ σωθήσεται διὰ τῆς τεκνογονίας ἐὰν μείνωσιν ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ καὶ ἁγιασμῷ μετὰ σωφροσύνης
verses.transliteration: de sōthēsetai dia tēs teknogonias ean meinōsin en pistei kai agapē kai hagiasmō meta sōphrosynēs
verses.literal: vvv Women, however, will be saved through - childbearing if they continue in faith - love and holiness with self-control
